measure.measure_definition: Measured value: Partial Mayo score (PMS) at the specified assessment time; Participants; PMS assessed before treatment and after 24 weeks of treatment; within-group comparisons by Wilcoxon signed-rank test; between-group comparison after treatment by Mann–Whitney U test.; Partial Mayo score (PMS) is a clinical disease activity index. Values are recorded as median with interquartile range at baseline and week 24.

Occurrence: participants meeting the clinical remission definition at week 24; Participants; PMS assessed at week 24; ITT analysis with BOCF for missing data; between-group comparison by Chi-square test.; The Methods define remission at week 24 as PMS < 2 with no subscore > 1. The abstract gives PMS ≤ 2 with the same subscore rule. The boundary used for the published counts is unresolved.

Measured value: IBDQ-32 total score at the specified assessment time; Participants; IBDQ-32 total score assessed before treatment and after 24 weeks; within-group comparisons by Wilcoxon signed-rank test; between-group comparison after treatment by Mann–Whitney U test.; IBDQ-32 total score, a disease-specific quality-of-life measure; values recorded as median with interquartile range at baseline and week 24.

population.population_definition: Randomization to mesalamine plus placebo or mesalamine plus pentoxifylline; all randomized participants included in the ITT analysis.; Patients with mild-to-moderate ulcerative colitis (UC) randomized in the trial. ITT analysis includes all 60 randomized participants; missing PMS values handled by BOCF. No per-protocol restriction.
population.population_time_frame: Study enrollment window: February 2023 to May 2025; planned treatment for six months. Individual calendar follow-up dates not separately reported.
